claims.scope: For every finite cube, every genuine Boolean triple g_+,g_-,h, and every finite physical coordinate block B, the exact natural-log entropy decrement of F=(g_++g_-)/2+h(g_+-g_-)/2 equals one block-source channel plus 2^|B|-1 selector-frequency channels, qD_B(h), and the signed block remainder R_B^sh defined in BLOCK_REASSOCIATION.tex.
hypotheses: g_+, g_-, h are genuine Boolean signs on the same cube
B is any finite set of physical coordinates
products are physical products and block coefficients use exact signed convolution
claims.parameter_dependence: exact identity; no dimension, block-size, depth, bias, overlap, or collision-separation constant

claims.scope: For every block B and every ordering pi of its coordinates, the sequential one-query four-channel ledger and simultaneous block ledger differ by the exact signed transfer T_pi=L_pi-L_B: M_pi=M_B-T_pi and D_B(F)=L_pi+M_pi=L_B+M_B. T_pi can be nonzero and order-dependent for genuine activation-irreducible Boolean triples.
claims.finite_check: All 4096 two-bit Boolean triples and both orders: 2688 nonzero transfers, 1792 order-dependent, 960 order-dependent with both selector signs on nonempty disagreement support.
does_not_claim: no lower bound from the 2^|B|-1 channel count
no failure of a future order-independent aggregate gauge
no dimension-free payment of the complete hierarchy

claims.scope: Dimension-free payment of the complete biased coherent remainder over arbitrary adaptive physical hierarchies with one source-influence or terminal-reserve budget.
claims.prior_obstruction: The exact one-step remainder cannot be paid separately by the installed Bellman potential.
claims.new_obstruction: Across a block, source/crossed and child/remainder ledgers exchange an order-dependent signed reassociation transfer; naive channel-by-channel control exposes 2^|B|-1 channels.
claims.next_action: Represent T_pi as a normalized spectral-mixture associator and test a three-order cocycle/telescoping identity before applying any envelope.
